# data/out: the demo's data set

**Synthetic.** Every patient, visit, note, order, allergy and phone number here was generated by `data/generate.py` with
a fixed seed (`python data/generate.py --files-only` reproduces it byte for byte without a database). The hospital
chain is fictional: branches A/B/C (codes `BRA`, `BRB`, `BRC`), towns "City A/B/C", and phone numbers in the
undiallable `0000…` range. No real person or hospital is represented.

The images in `dicom/` and their previews in `thumbs/` are real, de-identified studies from The Cancer Imaging Archive
(CC BY 4.0), relabelled to the synthetic patients: see `dicom/NOTICE` and the README's image credits.

`truth_*.csv` say which record belongs to which person; they are never loaded into Exasol and only measure the patient
index (`data/check_mpi.py`).
